summary: Attention to Detail's Rollcage games and GRIP: Combat Racing, the later spiritual successor by Caged Element, all centered on ultra-fast double-sided vehicles that can drive on walls and ceilings while using combat powerups.

entries.title: GRIP: Combat Racing

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: GRIP: Combat Racing released for Windows, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch, and it is a spiritual successor to Rollcage. Windows is the highest-fidelity configurable route and preserves the full 4-player split-screen capability that is limited on Switch.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings; use PS4/Xbox One as console alternatives and Switch only for portable access.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spiritual successor, not an official Rollcage sequel from Psygnosis/Attention to Detail.
